findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_token_launch, get_protocol_meter, get_recent_activity, get_liquidity, get_raffle · Private data: get_daily_briefing, get_treasury_stats, get_brain_vs_flat, simulate_allocation, prepare_token_launch, get_projects, get_project_treasury, get_agent, get_vault_docs, list_rwas, get_rwa, get_autonomy, get_agent_passport, get_rwa_performance, get_holder_distribution, get_recent_activity, get_payout_integrity, get_lock_tier, get_proof_of_reserves, verify_claim, simulate_lock_boost, verify_day, verify_decision, get_liquidity, get_supply, get_raffle, get_strategies, get_strategy, get_my_vault, get_my_claims, get_my_performance · Public sink: prepare_token_launch, get_shadow_vs_brain, get_my_vault · Destructive: simulate_allocation, get_monthly_reports, get_proof_of_reserves, simulate_lock_boost, get_strategies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_token_launch, get_protocol_meter, get_recent_activity, get_liquidity, get_raffle · Private data: get_daily_briefing, get_treasury_stats, get_brain_vs_flat, simulate_allocation, prepare_token_launch, get_projects, get_project_treasury, get_agent, get_vault_docs, list_rwas, get_rwa, get_autonomy, get_agent_passport, get_rwa_performance, get_holder_distribution, get_recent_activity, get_payout_integrity, get_lock_tier, get_proof_of_reserves, verify_claim, simulate_lock_boost, verify_day, verify_decision, get_liquidity, get_supply, get_raffle, get_strategies, get_strategy, get_my_vault, get_my_claims, get_my_performance · Public sink: prepare_token_launch, get_shadow_vs_brain, get_my_vault · Destructive: simulate_allocation, get_monthly_reports, get_proof_of_reserves, simulate_lock_boost, get_strategies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
